name: Right Click Disable OR Ban
author: A WP Life

sections.description:
A most widely searched plugin feature by all the photography sites. Website owners who want to block users from copying their images and content can use this plugin to disable right-click functionality on their entire website.

How Right Click Disable Plugin Works?

Simply go to plugin settings menu page and enable or disable right click option for admin & visitors of your whole website.

Features:

  • Right Click Disable For Visitors and Users
  • Right Click Disable For Admin
  • Enable/Disable Alert Message on Right Click
  • Customizable Right Click Disable Message
  • Safari Browser Compatible
  • Lightweight and Fast
  • Translation Ready
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin from WordPress.org or install directly from your WordPress admin dashboard
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  3. Upload the plugin zip file and click “Install Now”
  4. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  5. Go to “Right Click Disable” menu in your admin dashboard
  6. Configure your settings:
    • Enable/Disable right click for visitors
    • Enable/Disable right click for admin
    • Enable/Disable the alert message
    • Customize the alert message text
  7. Click “Save Settings” button
  8. Visit your website and test the right click functionality

That’s it. You’re ready to go!
sections.faq:
How do I disable right click for visitors only?

Go to Right Click Disable settings, set “Disable Right Click For Visitors” to “Yes” and “Disable Right Click For Admin” to “No”, then save settings.

Can I show a custom message when right click is attempted?

Yes! You can enable the alert message option and customize the message text in the settings.

Can I disable right click without showing any message?

Yes, you can set “Show Alert Message” to “No” in the settings.

Does this work on mobile devices?

Yes, the plugin prevents long-press context menu on mobile devices as well.

Is this plugin compatible with Safari?

Yes, the plugin has been specifically optimized for Safari browser compatibility.

Have any queries?

Please post your question on plugin support forum

https://wordpress.org/support/plugin/right-click-disable-or-ban/
